caption: The drawing depicts a single metal teapot or watering can positioned in the center of a plain, light beige background. The object features a black handle on the left side and a long, narrow spout extending to the right. The body of the object is decorated with painted designs that include a large red and orange fruit, surrounded by clusters of smaller red circles and green leaves. The lid is shown slightly ajar and is topped with an upright oval element decorated with a yellow-gold leaf motif. The object is depicted in a realistic style with solid black outlines and colored highlights. The artist’s signature, “Geo. J. File,” appears in small text to the right of the object.
title: Teapot
